EUR, converted exactly from € millions. LEADER: Herbert Diess left the Board of Management on August 31, 2022; the 2025 report says his contract ran until October 24, 2025 and shows his 2025 remuneration, but gives no shareholding for him, so status is 'no-reported-stake'. HOLDERS: percentages are of subscribed capital (ordinary plus preferred), as the chart states, so they are economic. The Porsche and Piëch families' interest is held through Porsche SE; it is not listed separately, to avoid double counting, and the report gives no family look-through percentage. The chart's other categories (foreign institutional investors 19.4%, private shareholders/others 24.4%, German institutional investors 2.1%) are groups, not holders, so they are not listed. DIVIDENDS: €3,171 million to Volkswagen AG shareholders (retained-earnings column of the statement of changes in equity; the notes say the same €3,171 million was paid to Volkswagen AG shareholders); the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' of €4,460 million also includes €664 million to hybrid capital investors and €625 million to non-controlling interests, both excluded. BUYBACKS: 0; no purchases of own shares appear in the cash-flow statement or statement of changes in equity. STOCK COMP: null. Volkswagen's share-based payment consists only of cash-settled performance share plans based on the preferred share price; no shares are granted, and the notes give expenses by plan but no total, so no figure is recorded rather than summing. GEOGRAPHY: five regions as reported; the 'Hedges sales revenue' column (€238 million) is omitted, so segments sum to €321,674 million against the €321,913 million total.

It excludes the Chinese joint ventures; including them, the Group had 662,942 employees. Côte d'Ivoire and Hong Kong appear as rows in the 2025 table; Belgium fell from 3,561 to 782. The Group management report also gives employees by market including the joint ventures, which is not recorded because it is on a different basis. The report says the production network encompassed over 111 production sites including the Chinese joint ventures, 67 of them vehicle production plants, but there is no machine-readable plant list, so plants are not counted by country. Sites are named in the report text; the Wolfsburg headquarters address (Berliner Ring 2) is quoted from the report's voting-rights notices. The report has no U.S. state breakdown, and no taxes-by-country table (only Group and divisional income taxes paid). A separate Volkswagen tax transparency report was not checked.

The Q3 2026 interim report (October 29, 2026) shows the same 295,089,818 ordinary and 206,205,445 preferred shares as the weighted average for the third quarter of 2026, and no purchases of own shares or capital increases are reported, so the count is taken as current.
